reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
reserveReview.rationale: vCRED's public materials describe programmable vaults on Hemi with single-sided staking and protocol-managed strategies, but publish no verifiable reserve composition, attestation, or per-position breakdown. The envelope is therefore one aggregate classified basket with an explicit insufficient-evidence disposition rather than invented weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: vCRED public site; no verifiable reserve composition or attestation is published
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The credit-versus-crypto split, constituent assets, obligors, and weights inside the vCRED vaults are undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: No primary source publishes the vault composition, so the basket cannot be split or linked to tracked assets.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: vCRED describes smart-contract vaults with automated agents on Hemi; the reviewed sources do not establish who controls the vaults, any legal segregation or insolvency treatment, or whether deposited assets are redeployed beyond the described strategies.
